events.event: SW of the Maldives, torpedoes/shells and sinks British armed merchant FORT McCLOUD (7,127 tons) at about 02-01N 77-06E.
events.INITIAL_relevance: None; far southwest of INITIAL route and four days earlier.

events.event: Continues twelfth Indian Ocean/Bay patrol; no named successful attack in this window.
events.INITIAL_relevance: Potential intelligence asset in theater but exact position is not fixed closely enough to create contact.

events.event: Departs Penang on fourth war patrol toward the Calcutta/upper-Bay traffic area.
events.branch_route_guard: Because Branch Japan holds Chittagong, the later historical HC.44 Calcutta-to-Chittagong target chain cannot be auto-copied. The patrol instead hunts surviving Hooghly/Calcutta and Bay traffic until an event-local target is generated.

events.event: Continues western Indian Ocean reconnaissance/commerce patrol after Chagos reconnaissance.

Tokai_support: Penang/Sumatra departure-lane ASW cover continues; it protects Japanese traffic/submarine movement probabilistically but earns no kill without a datum.
